$comment: The film registry. scripts/lib/films.mjs checks it and writes every film's pages (web/f/<slug>/) and the home page from web/templates/; scripts/contract.mjs expands contract.yaml's films block from it. A live film is served and checked in full. A film in production (status in_production) is listed on the home page by title, dates and status only: no page, no media, no synopsis. A paused film is taken off this file. A caption track is offered only once its review is 'reviewed'. screenplay_path (optional): where the film's working screenplay lives on the render machine (~ is the home folder), so the engine's bed-reuse lint (GRAMMAR A29 refined) can refuse a score another film already plays; DOCUMENT_FILMS overrides it. balance_fallback: only the Partition pilot, whose live sources.json predates the balance block, may show its own figures without declaring one.

films.title: The Partition of India
films.logline: two midnights, a line, the roads, and those who stayed
films.synopsis: Two nations were born in the same week of August 1947. On the night of 14 August, in Delhi, Nehru told the Constituent Assembly that not far from Delhi, big cities were ablaze. A narrator tells it as one story, with readings from the record: the clock, the line, the two midnights, the roads beside the canals, Delhi itself, and those who stayed.
films.content_note: It tells of killing, abduction and flight.
films.shows: This film shows no bodies or killing.

related.line: Listen to void history's audio documentary on the Partition of India
